versions.content: XML Configuration of classes with atpMixedString The following default values are applied to classes with stereotype atpMixedString (if no other values are specified in the meta-model): • Default values of the stereotyped meta-class: – xml.ordered=false – xml.text=true • Default values of the properties of the stereotyped meta-class: – upper multiplicity = unbounded – lower multiplicity = 0 – xml.roleWrapperElement = false – xml.roleElement = true – xml.typeWrapperElement = false – xml.typeElement = true (if the type of the property has concrete subclasses), false (otherwise)
